key_impacts: Nuclear fuel melted inside reactors, requiring ongoing cooling to prevent further radioactive release.
Large volumes of highly contaminated water accumulated on site in storage tanks.
Complete decontamination stated to be impossible, indicating long-term environmental contamination.
evidence_snippets: Large-scale nuclear disaster at the TEPCO-operated Fukushima Daiichi Nuclear Power Plant, directly caused by the Great East Japan Earthquake and Tsunami of March 11, 2011.
Operators are circulating coolant water to cool the nuclear fuel that melted inside the nuclear reactors due to the accident.
The whole site of Fukushima Daiichi has been packed with 1,000 ton capacity tanks containing the contaminated water.
missing_information: Impact numbers missing (casualties, evacuees, economic losses).
Directly impacted settlements beyond the plant not explicitly named in the excerpt.
